Stakeholder communication.guidance: requirements The people or the groups of people who need to receive project information and their specific requirements

Information.guidance: Describe the information to be communicated, including language, format, content, and level of detail.

Method or media.guidance: Describe how the information will be delivered; for example, email, meetings, web meetings, etc.

Time frame and frequency.guidance: List how often the information is to be provided and under what circumstances.

Sender.guidance: Insert the name of the person or the group that will provide the information.

Communication constraints or.guidance: assumptions List any assumptions or constraints. Constraints can include descriptions of proprietary, secure, or sensitive information and relevant restrictions for distribution.

Glossary of common terminology.guidance: List any terms or acronyms unique to the project or that are used in a unique way.
